translationRepairs: He held Taiping, Kuangguo, Tianping, Zhongwu, Wuning, Guide, and Jinchang in turn. Inns lined the roads wherever he went, and he amassed tens of millions.
He held Taining, Kuangguo, Tianping, Zhongwu, Wuning, Guide, and Jinchang in turn. Inns lined the roads wherever he went, and he amassed tens of millions.
泰寧 is Taining; Taiping would require 太平.
By dawn he had killed them all. For merit he was made prefect of Cao.
By dawn he had killed them all. For merit he was made prefect of Chanzhou.
澶州 is Chanzhou, not Caozhou; spelling out the prefecture avoids the proposal's ambiguous one-syllable form.
That year he died at sixty-two, posthumously Grand Preceptor.
That year he died at sixty-two and was posthumously appointed Grand Commandant.
太尉 is Grand Commandant, not Grand Preceptor (太師) or Grand Marshal.
